Overview

Tula is a city in Tula Oblast with a population of 470,000. A historic city south of Moscow, famous for its gingerbread, samovars, and the Tula Kremlin, a key defensive fortress. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 4b growing zone supports Cold — cool-season crops, hardy perennials. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
